findings.title: Comment references a nonexistent migration name
findings.body: The comment points to '0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py' but the actual migration added in this series is 0920_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_revised. Following the comment leads to a file that does not exist, so the pointer to the correct migration is broken.

findings.title: Data-conversion migration silently disabled; org saved searches never converted
findings.body: The body of the 'revised' migration was replaced with a no-op that says the correct migration is 0921, but no 0921 migration exists in this change. Any deployment will skip the saved-search to view conversion entirely, and the comment is misleading. The removed test for 0917 also means the conversion logic is no longer covered.

findings.title: Logged event_data is the wrong variable in fire_actions_for_groups
findings.body: The log extra now uses workflow_event_data, but it is inside a per-workflow loop where other fields reference the group-level event. Changing the logged payload silently alters what is emitted; if workflow_event_data is undefined in that scope it raises NameError, otherwise it logs a different object than before. Needs confirmation of scope.

findings.title: Removal of ParameterizationRegexExperiment breaks public __all__ export and callers
findings.body: ParameterizationRegexExperiment is removed and dropped from __all__, while ParameterizationExperiment is redefined as only ParameterizationCallableExperiment. Any code that imports or constructs regex experiments will fail at import time. The traceparent option is also removed from options defaults without a migration for stored option values.

findings.title: Owner handling in update() is inconsistent with unchanged type/condition logic
findings.body: update() sets instance.type from validated_data.get('detector_type', instance.group_type), which uses a key that is never present in validated_data (the field is 'type'), so type silently resets to the existing value. Also owner is accepted in create/update without verifying it belongs to the organization in the validator, relying solely on ActorField.

findings.title: age/timestamp validators check initial_data truthiness, so age=0 bypasses mutual exclusion
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age test self.initial_data.get('age') / get('timestamp') for truthiness. A report with age=0 and timestamp present passes validation, violating the stated mutual-exclusion rule. Also the endpoint now returns 422 for any malformed report in the batch, changing behavior for the whole request.

findings.title: Error IDs fetched via response[0] without guarding for non-empty snuba result shape
findings.body: error_ids = response[0].get('error_ids', []) assumes process_raw_response returns a list of dicts; if the query returns rows lacking error_ids the endpoint silently sends no error context. Also the new query runs on every request before pagination, adding a Snuba round trip to the hot path.

findings.title: Typo in comment ('segements') and loose null handling
findings.body: The added comment contains a typo. More importantly, the early return for max_segment_id None is correct, but the MatchedRow type change is not reflected in fetch_rows_matching_pattern's query, which still uses max() that can return null for groups with no segments.

findings.title: New equations parameter is accepted but not forwarded to the RPC query path
findings.body: run_top_events_timeseries_query now accepts equations and passes it through, but the query() path and other callers were not updated, so equations-based top-N queries on logs still silently ignore equations in the caller chain that does not supply it.

findings.title: Visualize model changed from multi-yAxis to single yAxis while persisted URL/JSON format still uses yAxes arrays
findings.body: Visualize now holds one yAxis, but toJSON still emits yAxes: [this.yAxis] and BaseVisualize keeps yAxes arrays. Existing saved queries and URLs with multiple yAxes are split into multiple Visualize entries, changing layout and labels for saved explore queries. Callers such as useTopEvents and charts were changed to assume one yAxis, which drops multi-series overlays that users previously had.

findings.title: Attribute keys query switched from useApiQuery to useQuery, losing the project environment param and retry settings
findings.body: The new implementation drops environment, staleTime, refetchOnWindowFocus and retry options from the request and uses a generic useQuery with a queryKey that does not include the API path. Caching by queryKey may serve results across org or projects with the same options, and the environment filter that was previously sent is no longer applied.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table branch renders hardcoded empty data instead of real results
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is enabled, TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty tableData, discarding tableResults entirely. Users with the flag see an empty table for every table widget.

findings.title: Fallback column derivation crashes when tableData.meta is undefined
findings.body: Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields) dereferences meta without optional chaining on the first access, so a tableData object lacking meta throws, while other code paths use tableData?.meta and are guarded inconsistently.

findings.title: Summary card renders while isPending is true only after feature check
findings.body: The summary component returns null for the feature-gated path before checking isPending, but useFeedbackSummary runs its query regardless of feature gating in the render path. Minor: the query is enabled by the feature check, so the hook is consistent, but the isError branch hides errors silently with no logging.

findings.title: Replacing FlexSpacer with Flex.Item changes layout semantics without tests
findings.body: The FlexSpacer styled div (flex-grow:1) was replaced with Flex.Item grow={1}, which changes the rendered element and may alter spacing in tabs and filename layouts across many consumers. No visual or snapshot test covers this change.

findings.title: Removing the 'Type' row drops the variant type information from grouping UI
findings.body: All variant types previously displayed a 'Type' row with an explanatory tooltip. The change removes it entirely, so users can no longer see whether a variant is a component, custom fingerprint, built-in fingerprint, or performance problem; the tooltip explanations are lost too.

findings.title: AI summary project now taken from replayRecord, but the URL project param is no longer used
findings.body: The query uses replayRecord.project_id instead of the location project param. If replayRecord is undefined the project is undefined and the summary query is disabled, so the tab shows 'No summary' instead of loading, and the removed URL-based lookup is a behavior change not covered by tests.

findings.title: Top-N now enabled for multi-series charts that previously disabled it
findings.body: The guard that disabled topEvents when any visualize had multiple yAxes was removed, but the Visualize model is now single-yAxis and multi-yAxis queries are split. Top-N results with multiple y-axes can now be requested, which the backend and chart code were not built to handle together.

findings.title: New owner validation tests lack a team-owner-not-in-org case
findings.body: test_owner_not_in_organization covers a user from another org, but there is no equivalent for a team from another organization, so cross-org team ownership validation is untested.
